title: Improving Function Space Flow Matching with Kernel Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2609.38049v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative models for function-valued data, such as time series and solutions of partial differential equations, must learn distributions over infinite-dimensional spaces. Functional Flow Matching (FFM) extends Flow Matching to this setting, learning a velocity field whose flow transports a Gaussian prior to the data distribution, but it inherits the independent endpoint pairing of standard Flow Matching: in each batch, prior and data samples are matched arbitrarily, so the conditional bridge must traverse both the shared global structure of the dataset and instance-specific residuals. In function space this is harder to fix than in finite dimensions, since optimal transport (OT) on function spaces is delicate to formulate and a flat Euclidean surrogate ignores the geometry that distinguishes function-valued data. translated_title: 利用核最优传输改进函数空间流匹配
translated_abstract: 面向函数值数据（如时间序列和偏微分方程解）的生成模型必须学习无限维空间上的分布。函数流匹配（FFM）将流匹配扩展到这一设定，通过学习一个速度场，使其对应的流将高斯先验输运到数据分布；但它继承了标准流匹配的独立端点配对方式：在每个批次中，先验样本与数据样本被任意配对，因此条件桥接必须同时跨越数据集的共享全局结构和实例特定的残差。在函数空间中，这一问题比在有限维空间中更难解决，因为函数空间上的最优传输（OT）难以精确表述，而平坦的欧氏替代方法则忽略了区分函数值数据的几何结构。我们提出核函数流匹配，用基于核诱导的熵正则最优传输来取代独立配对……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出核函数流匹配，用核诱导的熵最优传输替换标准流匹配中任意的端点配对，从而利用函数空间的几何结构改进对函数值数据（如时间序列和偏微分方程解）的生成建模。
en_tdlr: Kernel Functional Flow Matching (kFFM) replaces the arbitrary independent endpoint pairing of standard Flow Matching with kernel-induced entropic optimal transport, leveraging the geometry of function spaces to improve generative modeling of function-valued data such as time series and PDE solutions.
